part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Each mutation step is embarrassingly parallel across the population, and swap/resample steps replace long serial traversals of correlated, multimodal parameter directions with population-level mixing, converting serial mixing time into parallel breadth.","reason":"Reframes sampling so compute buys mixing, but sampler sweeps still run sequentially; the population is coupled copies side by side, not serial steps computed simultaneously."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"All serial cost moves into the embarrassingly parallel simulation bank plus one training run; more compute linearly improves surrogate fidelity and tail coverage, and per-catchment inference cost no longer scales with chain length at all.","reason":"Eliminates the per-dataset serial chain: posteriors no longer wait on chain iterations, and the formerly serial simulation work is computed simultaneously in one parallel bank."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Change what is measured from likelihood values to gradients: reimplement the model in a differentiable framework (or derive its adjoint) and use HMC/NUTS, with ensemble Kalman inversion as a gradient-light fallback.","reason":"Genuine reframe (gradients buy reachable dimension), but HMC chains still iterate step-after-step; GPU parallelism only splits each forward/adjoint step, which does not count."}]}
